{{Top}}
'''Red Eight''' was the callsign of the eighth member of [[Red Squadron]]. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadrons with this name, and several beings went by the name Red Eight.

[[Bren Quersey/Legends|Bren Quersey]] flew for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as Red Eight during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during which he was killed in action.
